findings.title: No parameterized tests (Theories) used — all tests use Fact with sequential Assert.Throws
findings.rule_violated: xUnit best practices: parameterized tests ([Theory]) over repeated Assert.Throws in a single [Fact]
findings.remediation: Convert boundary tests to [Theory] with [InlineData]. If the first assertion throws/fails, the second never executes, masking defects. Same for Entry_SetScore_InvalidScore_Throws (tests 11 and -1 in one Fact).

findings.title: ContestJudging.Web project has zero unit tests
findings.rule_violated: Testing pyramid: missing unit tests for UI/presentation layer logic
findings.remediation: Add bunit or similar Blazor testing library. Test pure-logic methods: FindSuggestedPair(), GetFilteredEntries(), GeneratePartitions(), CalculateResults(), keyboard handler, DI validation. Add ContestJudging.Web.Tests project.

findings.title: No test categories/traits to distinguish unit tests from integration tests
findings.rule_violated: xUnit best practices: test categorization for CI pipeline efficiency
findings.remediation: Add [Trait("Category", "Unit")] to unit test classes and [Trait("Category", "Integration")] to InfrastructureTests. Configure CI with dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration" for PRs.

findings.title: ContestManager constructor takes concrete ContestDbContext; tests pass null!
findings.evidence_snippet: var manager = new ContestManager(mockCatRepo.Object, mockEntryRepo.Object, mockRelRepo.Object, mockValidation.Object, mockResolution.Object, mockScoring.Object, null!);
findings.rule_violated: SOLID:DIP — depending on concrete implementation instead of abstraction
findings.remediation: Introduce IDatabaseExportImport interface abstracting ExportDatabaseAsync/ImportDatabaseAsync, or add dedicated integration tests for those methods using a real in-memory context. The null! suppression masks fragility.

findings.title: ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices has no test coverage
findings.rule_violated: Testing: critical infrastructure/pathway code should have coverage
findings.remediation: Add a test that calls AddContestJudgingServices, builds IServiceProvider, resolves each registered service, and asserts non-null and correct concrete type. Use in-memory SQLite.

findings.title: Vague test class name 'CoreTests' — unclear what it tests
findings.rule_violated: Consistency: test class names should map to the class under test (e.g., CategoryTests, EntryTests)
findings.remediation: Split into CategoryTests.cs and EntryTests.cs, or rename to CoreEntityTests.

findings.title: E2E tests use NUnit while unit tests use xUnit — framework inconsistency
findings.rule_violated: Consistency: single test framework reduces cognitive load across the project
findings.remediation: Migrate E2E to xUnit (using Microsoft.Playwright without NUnit adapter) or document the rationale for the split.

findings.title: E2E project package versions missing from central package management
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- Directory.Packages.props has no entries for these E2E csproj references: -->
<PackageReference Include="NUnit" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit.Analyzers" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit3TestAdapter" />
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit" />
findings.rule_violated: Build integrity: central package management must cover all projects
findings.remediation: Add version entries to Directory.Packages.props for NUnit, NUnit.Analyzers, NUnit3TestAdapter, and Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit. Verify with dotnet restore.

findings.title: Repository edge cases untested (non-existent IDs, duplicates, nulls, empty tables)
findings.rule_violated: Testing: edge case and error path coverage
findings.remediation: Add tests for: GetByIdAsync with non-existent ID, AddAsync with duplicate ID, AddAsync with null entity, DeleteAsync with non-existent ID, UpdateAsync with non-existent entity, GetAllAsync on empty table.

findings.title: ContestManager ExportDataAsync/ImportDataAsync untested
findings.rule_violated: Testing: critical data path (backup/restore) has no coverage
findings.remediation: Add integration tests using in-memory context that verify round-trip: export, wipe, import, verify data matches.

findings.title: Dead placeholder code: Class1.cs in Infrastructure project
findings.remediation: Delete Class1.cs if it serves no purpose.

findings.title: TrimmingSafetyTests suppresses trimming warnings it's meant to validate
findings.rule_violated: Testing: trimming safety tests should validate behavior under trimming without suppressing trimming warnings
findings.remediation: Use source-generated JSON serializer (JsonSerializerContext) or remove [RequiresUnreferencedCode] and run this test explicitly in a trimmed publish build to detect actual breaks.

findings.title: No cancellation token support in async tests or underlying async methods
findings.rule_violated: Testing: async tests should validate cancellation behavior where applicable
findings.remediation: If the underlying async operations support cancellation, add tests with CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan). If not, consider adding CancellationToken support to repository interfaces.
